main_edit_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit and background-extraction.
EDIT the first provided original game UI screenshot. The second image is the user's colored ANNOTATION GUIDE ONLY, not an asset to reproduce. Blue annotation marks the white/ivory background that should become transparent; red marks the bottom toolbar that must remain opaque. Remove every annotation mark from the output. Produce ONE full 16:9 game overlay PNG with TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA; target 1920x1080 visual layout for a 480x270 desktop companion window. Do not trim/crop the overall frame or reflow the layout.

Required edits:
1. Remove the entire ivory/white SKY/background above the pond waterline and around the animal, rod, plants and catch card, making all that NEGATIVE SPACE fully transparent (alpha 0). This includes the gap inside the rod arch and between fishing line, rod and environment. No painted transparency checkerboard, no fake desktop, no grey background and no glow halo. Keep crisp outlined artwork and anti-aliased edges.
2. Remove the entire full-width ivory TOP HEADER BACKPLATE and its horizontal divider. Delete the top-left Chinese title "一起摸鱼" and the nine-dot drag symbol completely; their whole area becomes transparent. The top-right room, mute, collapse and close buttons remain as FOUR discrete OPAQUE floating controls, with their own cream/lilac fills and dark outlines. No long topbar behind them.
3. Preserve the entire bottom navigation toolbar FULLY OPAQUE, including its cream backplate, black top boundary and all five controls/labels: "路亚", "鱼篓", "收藏", "记录", "更多". Preserve their order, size and position. The opacity is not reduced.
4. Preserve the catch notification card at upper right FULLY OPAQUE, including its cream interior, lilac heading, minnow art, "新鱼获", "23.6 cm", and close icon. Background transparency is NOT white-color keying: cream animal muzzle/belly, card, float, UI, rod details remain opaque.
5. Preserve the same taupe bean-shaped otter character, cream muzzle/belly, pose, rod, reel, wooden dock, waterline location and thick slightly irregular black felt-tip outlines, G deadpan doodle style.
6. Change the UNNATURALLY PURPLE POND WATER to a calm natural muted JADE/TEAL GREEN, around #7FAE9E or #81B6A5, no purple water. Change acid-yellow foliage/lily pads to a calm natural yellow-green around #A8C779, and lotus petals to a restrained dusty pink #D5A0AD. Keep simplified shapes and black outlines, no realistic water or detailed texture. Purple may remain on UI accents and original fish only. All water, land, plants, character, rod and dock remain fully opaque; only background negative space becomes alpha.
7. Keep the 16:9 rectangular CANVAS, but no enclosing window border/frame and no solid bounding rectangle around the floating scene.

Do not add a title, dots, new drag handle, taskbar, app-window backdrop or extra UI. Preserve all untargeted details. Transparent upper-space is intended to show the user's desktop, while bottom toolbar and secondary cards are readable opaque elements. Mouse click-through will be separately implemented; do not draw any explanations in the image.

1. Remove the transient "新鱼获" catch card completely from the upper-right empty area, restoring true alpha transparency behind it.
2. Open ONE fully OPAQUE cream secondary popup menu anchored immediately above the bottom-right "更多" navigation item.
